newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen school gunman condemned to death.
newsitem.headline: Yemen school gunman condemned to death.

text.p: A Yemeni court on Monday sentenced to death a man accused of killing a headmistress, a teacher and three children in an armed attack on hundreds of children at two schools, witnesses said.
"The court sentences the murderer to execution by firing squad...," the three-judge panel said to a packed courtroom.
The defendant Mohammad Ahmad Misleh, who appeared calm, said after the sentencing he wanted to appeal against the verdict and the prosecutor general said the appeal hearing would be held on Tuesday.
The court had named two lawyers to defend Misleh.
The prosecutor general had charged Misleh at the start of the trial on Monday morning with the murder on Sunday of five people, attempted murder of 12 others and resisting arrest.

Misleh was in a wheelchair behind the steel bars of a cage in the packed courtroom. The Yemeni man was wounded in an exchange of fire with police on Sunday after he shot at hundreds of students aged between six and 18 as they lined up at two schools to go into morning classes.
